AiEvaluationDefinition.description: Actions and outcomes of the CV Review Agent on the demo data. Routed requests are checked by the actions called (the new builder reports the router, agent_router, as the topic).
AiEvaluationDefinition.name: CV Review Agent Tests

expectation.expectedValue: The agent reports the card of Karim El Fassi: fields filled, skills added, and the missing, inferred and conflicting values. It does not show record ids.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: Create the candidate card of Karim El Fassi

expectation.expectedValue: The agent quotes the CV (10 years stated) and mentions that the job dates give fewer years. It does not invent anything.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: What does Karim El Fassi's CV say about his years of experience?

expectation.expectedValue: The agent names the applicants whose CV mentions Docker, with a quote, and says there is no evidence for the others.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: Who has worked with Docker among the applicants of the Senior Salesforce Developer job?

expectation.expectedValue: The agent recommends one or more candidates, shows the ranking with scores and match levels, explains trade-offs and gaps, and offers to bookmark a candidate.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: Compare the applicants for the Senior Salesforce Developer job

expectation.expectedValue: The agent shows the ranking. If no applicant scores 75 or more it says there is no strong match, gives the best available option and the gaps to check in interview.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: Compare the applicants for the Data Analyst job

expectation.expectedValue: The agent does not answer the weather question and redirects to what it can help with.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: What's the weather in Paris today?
